_provenance.note: Actual response subset from the EGT Digital public sports API, captured live. A "lobby container" is a curated bundle of events with their markets and prices. The event list is an OBJECT keyed by sportEventId. Each market carries marketTemplateName/marketTitle for the window and outcomes[].name + outcomes[].odds. The match RESULT is the market whose outcome names are 1 / X / 2 — several other three-way markets appear on the same events and are NOT 1X2. `live` is a boolean; prematch means live === false.
_provenance.gate: A bare request without those headers returns HTTP 488 "Missing user device header!".
